g.text: Functional structure: behavior, capacity and accepted history damage
Equal four-family rate mean within each seed
Seeds are the independent units (n=3). SD is between seeds; trials/events do not add n. No accepted batch → undefined history fraction; no zero substitution. Mixed improvement can harm history.
